# netbox_virtual_machine (Data Source)

Retrieves a single virtual machine from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_machine" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  device_id = 1
}

output "virtual_machine_id" {
  value = data.netbox_virtual_machine.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the virtual machine.

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster associated with the virtual machine.
- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device associated with the virtual machine.
- `site_id` (Number) The ID of the site associated with the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the virtual machine.
- `config_context` (String) The config context of the virtual machine.
- `config_template_id` (Number) The ID of the config template associated with the virtual machine.
- `created` (String) When the virtual machine was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the virtual machine, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the virtual machine.
- `disk` (Number) The disk of the virtual machine.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interface_count` (Number) The number of interface objects that refer to the virtual machine.
- `last_updated` (String) When the virtual machine was last changed.
- `local_context_data` (String) The local context data of the virtual machine.
- `memory` (Number) The memory of the virtual machine.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the virtual machine.
- `platform_id` (Number) The ID of the platform associated with the virtual machine.
- `primary_ip4_id` (Number) The ID of the primary ip4 associated with the virtual machine.
- `primary_ip6_id` (Number) The ID of the primary ip6 associated with the virtual machine.
- `primary_ip_id` (Number) The ID of the primary ip associated with the virtual machine.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the virtual machine.
- `serial` (String) The serial of the virtual machine.
- `start_on_boot` (String) The start on boot of the virtual machine.
- `status` (String) The status of the virtual machine.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the virtual machine.
- `vcpus` (Number) The vcpus of the virtual machine.
- `virtual_disk_count` (Number) The number of virtual disk objects that refer to the virtual machine.
- `virtual_machine_type_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual machine type associated with the virtual machine.
